products.title: Ortino LO Brace
products.summary: A lightweight lumbar orthosis with an advanced pulley system and memory-foam back panel for everyday lower-back support.

faq.q: Is long-term use of a back brace harmful?
faq.a: Continuous, unsupervised use can weaken the back muscles and create dependence. Use it as needed and follow medical advice.

faq.q: What is the difference between LO and LSO?
faq.a: The LO supports the lumbar area only, while the LSO also supports the sacral/pelvic area with a larger, height-adjustable back panel — better suited to more severe disc problems or post-surgery.

faq.q: How does memory foam differ from regular foam?
faq.a: Memory foam adapts to the shape of your back and keeps its form over time, while regular foam compresses and loses effectiveness.

faq.q: How should I adjust the brace?
faq.a: Place it around your waist, then tighten gradually with the pulley until it fits your body. Pressure should be even — firm but not too tight.

products.title: Ortino LSO Brace
products.summary: An advanced lumbosacral orthosis with a height-adjustable rigid back panel and detachable side panels for lower back and pelvic support.

faq.q: How is this brace different from ordinary belts?
faq.a: It combines a rigid LSO back panel, pulley tightening and breathable materials, so it supports the spine far more effectively than elastic belts.

faq.q: Is the pulley cord durable?
faq.a: Yes. The cord is designed for repeated tightening and long-term use.

faq.q: Can the LSO be converted into an LO?
faq.a: Yes. Thanks to its modular design, the side parts can be removed to use it as an LO brace.

faq.q: How do I wash it?
faq.a: Remove the rigid parts and hand-wash the fabric in lukewarm water with a mild detergent, then air-dry away from direct heat.

products.title: Ortino TLSO Brace
products.summary: A complete thoraco-lumbo-sacral orthosis with LSO and TLSO polymer panels and cross-strap system for full spinal support.

faq.q: How does the TLSO differ from LO and LSO models?
faq.a: The TLSO adds thoracic support through a taller panel and cross straps, providing the most complete support in the range.

faq.q: What does “modular design” mean?
faq.a: Parts can be added or removed, so the TLSO can be converted into an LSO or LO brace as needed.

faq.q: Can it be used instead of a posture corrector?
faq.a: It does encourage upright posture, but it is a medical spinal brace. For posture alone, a dedicated posture corrector is usually more appropriate.

faq.q: Who should not use it?
faq.a: People with skin conditions at the contact area or conditions where a doctor advises against bracing. Always consult your physician.

products.title: Ortino TLSO PLUS Brace
products.summary: A high-support spinal orthosis with an adjustable sternal pad for complete thoracic and lumbar stabilisation.

faq.q: How much does it restrict spinal movement?
faq.a: It significantly limits flexion and rotation while still allowing everyday activities.

faq.q: What is the sternal pad for?
faq.a: It presses gently on the breastbone to keep the upper spine upright and prevent forward bending.

faq.q: How many hours a day should I wear it?
faq.a: Wear time depends on your condition and must be set by your doctor.

faq.q: Is it only for post-surgery use?
faq.a: No. It is also used for fractures, instability and other conditions needing strong spinal support.

products.title: Ortino Spinomed Brace
products.summary: A backpack-style spinal orthosis with an aluminium splint that supports the spine in osteoporosis and back-muscle weakness.

faq.q: Is it suitable for people with a larger build?
faq.a: Yes. The straps are adjustable for different body sizes; the orthotist will fit them correctly.

faq.q: Can it replace a posture corrector?
faq.a: It provides stronger, medical-grade spinal support than a posture corrector and should be used on medical advice.

faq.q: Can it be worn under clothing?
faq.a: Yes, its slim design allows it to be worn under most clothing.

products.title: Ortino Posture Corrector
products.summary: A lightweight, breathable posture corrector that supports the shoulders and spine and helps correct rounded shoulders.

faq.q: Is it suitable for different body heights?
faq.a: Yes, the straps are adjustable to fit different body types.

faq.q: Can it be worn under clothing?
faq.a: Yes, it is slim enough to be worn under everyday clothes.

faq.q: Is it suitable for women?
faq.a: Yes, it can be used by both men and women.

faq.q: How do I clean it?
faq.a: Hand-wash in lukewarm water with mild detergent and air-dry.

products.title: Ortino Rehab Knee Brace
products.summary: A hinged rehabilitation knee brace with a lockable, graduated range-of-motion joint for ligament injuries and post-operative recovery.

faq.q: Is it suitable for ACL and PCL injuries?
faq.a: Yes. It is designed to stabilise the knee and control movement after these injuries and surgeries.

faq.q: Can it be used on both the left and right leg?
faq.a: Yes, it fits either leg.

faq.q: How is it different from simple elastic knee supports?
faq.a: Its rigid hinges and adjustable range of motion give far more control and protection than elastic sleeves.

faq.q: Does it restrict natural knee movement?
faq.a: Only as much as you set on the hinge; your clinician will choose the appropriate range.

products.title: Ortino Rebound Dual Knee Brace
products.summary: A specialist ligament knee brace with a polycentric hinge, precise range-of-motion control and height adjustment.

faq.q: How is it different from elastic knee supports?
faq.a: It has rigid frames and a polycentric hinge that actively control motion, while elastic supports only provide compression.

faq.q: Can I use it without a prescription?
faq.a: It should be prescribed by a doctor and fitted by an orthotist to ensure correct settings.

faq.q: Will it slip during walking or sport?
faq.a: No. Its suspension system and correct fitting keep it in place.

faq.q: Does continuous use weaken the muscles?
faq.a: Using it as prescribed alongside your exercise programme helps prevent muscle weakness.

products.title: Ortino Unloader Knee Brace
products.summary: An unloader brace for knee osteoarthritis that shifts load away from the worn side of the joint to reduce pain.

faq.q: How does an unloader brace reduce pain?
faq.a: It applies gentle corrective forces that shift weight away from the damaged side of the knee, lowering joint pressure.

faq.q: Can it slow joint wear?
faq.a: By reducing load on the worn area it may help limit further wear, alongside your doctor’s treatment plan.

faq.q: Is it suitable for daily walking?
faq.a: Yes. It is designed for everyday activity and walking.

products.title: Ortino Knee Immobilizer Brace
products.summary: A three-panel knee immobiliser with aluminium stays and a pulley system to keep the knee still after injury or surgery.

faq.q: What is the advantage of the pulley system?
faq.a: It tightens evenly and quickly with one hand, without the loosening of traditional straps and Velcro.

faq.q: How long should it be worn?
faq.a: Your surgeon will specify the duration based on your procedure and recovery.

faq.q: Is it suitable for sports injuries?
faq.a: Yes, when the injury requires temporary immobilisation of the knee.

faq.q: What do the aluminium stays do?
faq.a: They keep the knee in extension and prevent unwanted bending.

products.title: Ortino Post OP Knee Brace
products.summary: A post-operative knee brace with an adjustable hinge and Quick Lock to stabilise the knee and control its range of motion.

faq.q: How long should the brace stay on?
faq.a: Follow your surgeon’s instructions — duration depends on the procedure and recovery stage.

faq.q: Will my knee become dependent on it?
faq.a: When used as prescribed and combined with physiotherapy, dependence is unlikely.

faq.q: Can I wear it while sleeping?
faq.a: Often yes after surgery, but only if your doctor recommends it.

faq.q: Can I walk or exercise in it?
faq.a: Walking is usually allowed with the hinge set appropriately; exercise should follow your rehab plan.

products.title: Ortino Swedish Knee Brace
products.summary: A Swedish-type knee orthosis with bilateral hinges that prevents knee hyperextension (genu recurvatum).

faq.q: Does fitting require a specialist?
faq.a: Yes. It should be fitted and adjusted by an orthotist.

faq.q: Is it comfortable for long-term use?
faq.a: Yes. Its padding and materials are designed for extended daily wear.

faq.q: Does it restrict normal knee movement?
faq.a: No. It only limits backward bending while allowing normal walking.

products.title: Ortino 4 Spring Knee Support
products.summary: A neoprene knee support with four lateral springs and adjustable Velcro straps for stronger joint stability.

faq.q: Who is it for?
faq.a: People who need more support than a simple sleeve — for mild to moderate pain or a feeling of instability.

faq.q: Can I wear it all day?
faq.a: It is designed for long wear, but take regular breaks and follow your clinician’s advice.

products.title: Ortino Neoprene Knee Support
products.summary: A light, spring-free neoprene knee sleeve that gives gentle support and keeps the joint warm.

faq.q: How is it different from the 4-spring support?
faq.a: It offers gentle compression and warmth without springs or straps, while the 4-spring model gives stronger lateral support.

products.title: Ortino Malleo Ankle Brace
products.summary: A slim ankle brace with the Quick Fit pulley system and two aluminium stays for stability after sprains and surgery.

faq.q: Is it suitable for daily use and sport?
faq.a: Yes. Its slim profile fits in shoes for both everyday wear and sport.

faq.q: How do I find the right size?
faq.a: Measure the circumference of your ankle and use the size table.

faq.q: What if my ankle is swollen?
faq.a: Measure the swollen ankle; the pulley system allows extra adjustment as swelling reduces.

faq.q: Is it suitable for fractures?
faq.a: It is not a fracture cast. Use it for fractures only if your doctor recommends it.

products.title: Ortino Patella Brace
products.summary: An advanced patella strap with the Quick Fit pulley system that stabilises the kneecap and relieves patellar tendon pain.

faq.q: Is the pulley cord durable?
faq.a: Yes. The pulley and cord are designed for strength and long service life.

faq.q: Does it make the knee hot or sweaty?
faq.a: Its breathable materials and small contact area keep heat and sweating to a minimum.

faq.q: Will it slip while moving?
faq.a: When sized and tightened correctly it stays in place during activity.

faq.q: Does it replace medical treatment?
faq.a: No. It supports treatment and physiotherapy but does not replace them.

products.title: Ortino Foot Drop Brace
products.summary: A light foot-drop orthosis with the Quick Fit pulley that lifts the foot to improve walking — at home or attached to a shoe.

faq.q: What is the difference between Foot Drop and Foot Drop Plus?
faq.a: Foot Drop Plus uses two pulleys for finer adjustment and more support; the standard model is lighter and simpler.

faq.q: How much does it improve walking?
faq.a: By lifting the foot it prevents toe drag and tripping, making walking safer and more natural.

faq.q: Can I wear it while sleeping?
faq.a: It is designed for walking; use at night only if your doctor advises it.

products.title: Ortino Foot Drop Plus Brace
products.summary: An advanced dual-pulley foot-drop orthosis for stronger, finely adjustable support after stroke, MS or nerve injury.

faq.q: How is it different from the standard Foot Drop brace?
faq.a: The Plus model adds a second pulley for finer, stronger and more balanced correction.

faq.q: How long does it last?
faq.a: With proper care, its quality materials and cord are built for long-term daily use.

products.title: Ortino Bionic Wrist Brace
products.summary: An advanced wrist brace with the Quick Fit pulley and aluminium splint for wrist pain, sprains and rehabilitation — left or right hand.

faq.q: How is it different from strap-and-elastic wrist supports?
faq.a: The pulley and aluminium splint provide firmer, more even support that does not loosen over time.

faq.q: Can it be used on both hands?
faq.a: Yes, it fits both the right and left hand.

faq.q: Can I use it for heavy lifting?
faq.a: It can support the wrist, but follow your clinician’s advice for heavy sports such as weightlifting.

products.title: Ortino Wrist Thumb Brace
products.summary: A wrist and thumb brace with two aluminium splints to relieve pain and stabilise the thumb in tendinitis, arthritis and carpal tunnel syndrome.

faq.q: Can it be used on either hand?
faq.a: Yes, it is designed for both right and left hands.

faq.q: How tight should it be?
faq.a: Firm but comfortable — loosen or remove it if you feel numbness or severe pain.

products.title: Ortino Post OP Elbow Orthosis
products.summary: A post-operative elbow orthosis with an adjustable hinge and shoulder sling to control elbow motion during recovery.

faq.q: Is it suitable after complex surgery such as tendon or ligament repair?
faq.a: Yes, when prescribed by your surgeon with the hinge set to the required range.

faq.q: How long should I use it?
faq.a: Your doctor will determine the duration based on your injury and recovery.

faq.q: Can it replace physiotherapy?
faq.a: No. It protects the joint while physiotherapy restores movement and strength.

products.title: Ortino Elbow Tennis Brace
products.summary: A tennis-elbow strap with the Quick Fit pulley that reduces strain on the forearm tendons in tennis and golfer’s elbow.

faq.q: How does it reduce pain?
faq.a: Targeted pressure on the forearm muscles reduces the strain transmitted to the irritated tendon attachment.

faq.q: How do I use it for golfer’s elbow?
faq.a: Rotate the pad so it sits over the inner forearm muscles, just below the elbow.

faq.q: Can I wear it under clothing?
faq.a: Yes, its slim profile fits under sleeves.

faq.q: How long until I notice improvement?
faq.a: Many people feel relief quickly; full recovery depends on rest, exercises and medical treatment.
